assumptions: 提交边界为临时粗略边界，官方 polygon 发布后必须重算。
site_area_sqm.note_zh: 临时总体设计范围面积，与公告约11.4平方公里同量级，仅用于设计推演。
site_area_sqm.note_en: Provisional overall design-area area, same order as the announced ~11.4 km2; for design reasoning only.

assumptions: 提交边界为临时粗略边界，官方 polygon 发布后必须重算。
key_area_total_sqm.note_zh: 三处重点区域临时面积合计，公告值约368.4公顷。
key_area_total_sqm.note_en: Total provisional area of the three key areas; the announced value is about 368.4 ha.

key_area_count.note_zh: 重点详细设计区域数量，与公告一致。
key_area_count.note_en: Number of key detailed-design areas, consistent with the announcement.

land_use_coverage_ratio.note_zh: 用地图层对提交边界的覆盖率，1.0 表示无缝无空白。
land_use_coverage_ratio.note_en: Coverage of the submitted boundary by the land-use layer; 1.0 means seamless with no gaps.

green_space_area_sqm.note_zh: 遗址公园主脉与生态指状绿地合计面积。
green_space_area_sqm.note_en: Total area of the park spine and ecological finger greens.

green_ratio.note_zh: 绿地占比，反映连续绿脉在带状范围中的骨架作用。
green_ratio.note_en: Green ratio, showing the structural role of the continuous green spine in the linear scope.

public_space_area_sqm.note_zh: 六处具身城市单元（EUZ）广场面积合计。
public_space_area_sqm.note_en: Total area of the six embodied urban zone (EUZ) plazas.

public_space_ratio.note_zh: 公共空间占比；EUZ 广场为高强度人机共处场所，不追求面积最大化。
public_space_ratio.note_en: Public-space ratio; EUZ plazas are intensive human-machine coexistence places rather than area maximisation.

assumptions: 现状建筑、权属和控规条件缺失，基底为设计示意。
building_footprint_area_sqm.note_zh: 示意性更新建筑基底面积，仅表达研究对象规模量级，不构成拆改留结论。
building_footprint_area_sqm.note_en: Indicative renewal footprint area expressing study-object magnitude only; not a retain/renovate/demolish conclusion.

slow_mobility_network_length_m.note_zh: 慢行主廊、东西缝合链接与EUZ接驳环线的中心线总长。
slow_mobility_network_length_m.note_en: Total centreline length of the slow-mobility spine, east-west stitching links and EUZ interchange loops.

east_west_stitch_link_count.note_zh: 东西向缝合慢行链接数量，用于回应铁路遗留的东西断裂。
east_west_stitch_link_count.note_en: Number of east-west stitching links responding to rail-legacy severance.

embodied_zone_l3_l4_area_sqm.note_zh: 机器人常驻区与自主运行验证区合计面积，是具身试验场的核心供给。
embodied_zone_l3_l4_area_sqm.note_en: Combined area of robot-resident and autonomous-validation zones, the core supply of the embodied testbed.

embodied_zone_l3_l4_ratio.note_zh: 高等级具身单元占比，控制在有限比例以保证人行优先区不被侵占。
embodied_zone_l3_l4_ratio.note_en: Share of higher-level embodied zones, deliberately limited so pedestrian-priority areas are not displaced.

euz_plaza_count.note_zh: 具身城市单元广场数量。
euz_plaza_count.note_en: Number of embodied urban zone plazas.

phase_count.note_zh: 实施分期数量（建议，非审定安排）。
phase_count.note_en: Number of implementation phases (suggestion, not an approved arrangement).

ai_scenario_card_count.note_zh: AI场景卡数量，任务书要求不少于10张。
ai_scenario_card_count.note_en: Number of AI scenario cards; the taskbook requires at least 10.

industry_test_scenario_count.note_zh: 产业测试验证场景数量，任务书要求不少于3个。
industry_test_scenario_count.note_en: Number of industry test/validation scenarios; the taskbook requires at least 3.

persona_count.note_zh: 用户画像类别数量，任务书要求不少于5类。
persona_count.note_en: Number of user personas; the taskbook requires at least 5.

pilgrimage_landmark_count.note_zh: AI朝圣地标数量，任务书要求不少于3个。
pilgrimage_landmark_count.note_en: Number of AI pilgrimage landmarks; the taskbook requires at least 3.

global_case_study_count.note_zh: 全球AI创新生态案例数量，任务书要求5-8个。
global_case_study_count.note_en: Number of global AI ecosystem cases; the taskbook requires 5-8.

renewal_project_count.note_zh: 更新项目清单条目数量。
renewal_project_count.note_en: Number of renewal project list entries.

floor_area_ratio.reason: 待正式数据补齐 / pending official control data: Approved FAR controls and the official boundary are not available, so it cannot be recomputed.
floor_area_ratio.note_zh: 缺少法定控规容积率条件与官方边界，无法复算。
floor_area_ratio.note_en: Approved FAR controls and the official boundary are not available, so it cannot be recomputed.

building_height_limit_m.reason: 待正式数据补齐 / pending official control data: Statutory building-height controls are not available.
building_height_limit_m.note_zh: 缺少控规建筑高度管控条件。
building_height_limit_m.note_en: Statutory building-height controls are not available.

road_redline_width_m.reason: 待正式数据补齐 / pending official control data: Road redlines and engineering conditions are unavailable; links are conceptual alignments only.
road_redline_width_m.note_zh: 缺少道路红线与工程条件，慢行链接仅为概念线位。
road_redline_width_m.note_en: Road redlines and engineering conditions are unavailable; links are conceptual alignments only.

resident_population.reason: 待正式数据补齐 / pending official control data: Official street-level resident population data for the scope is unavailable.
resident_population.note_zh: 缺少范围内分街道常住人口官方数据。
resident_population.note_en: Official street-level resident population data for the scope is unavailable.

ai_enterprise_count_in_scope.reason: 待正式数据补齐 / pending official control data: District-level AI enterprise counts are public, but an in-scope enterprise register is not; no extrapolation is made.
ai_enterprise_count_in_scope.note_zh: 海淀全区AI企业数量为公开数据，但范围内企业名录未公开，不做推算。
ai_enterprise_count_in_scope.note_en: District-level AI enterprise counts are public, but an in-scope enterprise register is not; no extrapolation is made.
